This native cancellation was preventive, not a resource timeout or a demonstrated native product failure.

last_screen.interpretation: Windows OOBE/startup screen; no product UI is visible. A retained screen is a sample, not proof that later activity never occurred.

resource_observations.interpretation: Recorded CPU/memory/disk preflight passed and sampled resources did not breach its guards. These counters do not establish a performance cause, exclude every bottleneck, or reconstruct resources in older runs.

cancellation_observability.qemu_shutdown_warning_preserved: QEMU reported a TPM shutdown warning during termination; raw qemu.log retained without inferring product behavior.

next_run.role: Current continuation reported by root; no outcome asserted here.
